description: This is a Java test class for EncounterEditor, a property editor in the OpenMRS project. It extends a base test class and includes setup for testing EncounterEditor, referencing the EncounterService to retrieve an Encounter instance for testing purposes.

classes.name: EncounterEditorTest
classes.description: Test class for EncounterEditor, extending BasePropertyEditorTest, focused on testing property editing of Encounter objects.
